profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead at DRW
profile.summary: I want to improve as a team member and software craftsman. I am interested in Lean, Agile, and Software Craftsmanship.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Optimized NoSQL database interaction and data processing performance
- Performed system administration for business critical data systems
- Quickly familiarized myself in new technologies multiple times over the summer, including ￼Storm and Spark.

positions.title: CSSE Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I am an assistant for CSSE221, the honors introduction course for the CSSE department.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Shipped a Top Grossing iPad App for iOS 8.
- Learned Objective-C and Cocoa Touch development in the context of iOS apps
- Joined the OmniFocus 2 for iPad team and contributed features
- Worked within Omni’s unique development process

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with small team of developers
- Built a ticketing system, accompanying back-end administration and reporting interfaces
- Collaborated with clients to ensure a quality user experience
- Optimized database queries in SQL for reporting
- Extracted and manipulated OpenGov data to provide valuable information to the public
- Finished project early, and under budget, allowing for more design work

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
- Built an MVP for a multitenant private content platform
- Integrated a payment processor for user subscription and tenant payments
- Acted as Technical Advisor to client and sole Developer

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with 7 different teams over 8 weeks
- Organized Geekfest, a weekly developer meet up, sponsored by Groupon
- Gave a Geekfest talk on my current experience and my previous 3 experiences.

positions.title: Apprentice
positions.description: I collaborated in the development of Ruby on Rails applications for multiple clients, interacted with LeanDog's various Agile teams. I was mentored by Michael "Doc" Norton during my time here.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I worked within 2Checkout.com's multiple web applications, developing features and repairing defects.

positions.title: Apprentice
positions.description: I am working as an apprentice to Joe O'Brien, CEO and Co-Founder. I am learning the craft of code and how a techcentric business is run. Helped to plan JRubyConf 2011.

projects.title: Cigna - Challenge Participant
projects.description: Submitted proposal to Cigna for a project - "Uncover trends in healthcare spending" on MindSumo platform.
